description: BOISE, Idaho — Governor Brad Little’s Leading Idaho Plan calls for investing $75 million to refurbish state veteran’s homes to provide each person with their own room and bathroom while creating other safety measures to help care for Idaho’s vets. The Idaho Division of Veterans Services runs three Idaho State Veterans Homes one in Boise, Pocatello and Lewiston …
